verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any built-in, Floot-managed LLM or agent capability that a generated app can call at runtime. generate_image only writes AI images into the project at build time. For third-party integrations, the docs say the user types their own key into Floot's secure dialog, which is the opposite of not managing provider keys. The built-in list covers database, OAuth, email, push, analytics and scheduled jobs, but not AI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can add AI features like LLM calls and agents to my generated app without managing provider keys myself
